1.consolidated_definition: Poner banderillas a las personas que deben pagar los gastos de una fiesta. (Por atracar, asaltar a uno, se usó en España. Covarrubias). “En su inexperiencia de lo que son esas capas y de los disgustos que cuestan, se dejó capear por la bailadora.” Fernando Ormaechea, Potpurrit de aires puertorriqueños, 1884.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To place banderillas on individuals who are responsible for covering the expenses of a party. (Used in Spain to refer to robbing or assaulting someone, as noted by Covarrubias). "In her inexperience with what those social classes entail and the discomforts they cause, she allowed herself to be taken advantage of by the dancer." Fernando Ormaechea, Potpourri de aires puertorriqueños, 1884.
